outcome: heart rate variability (HRV) time-domain metrics (alpha 1, alpha 2, RMS1, RMS2)
cohort: The participants were 56 preterm infants from two different NICUs (28 from a high-morbidity regional referral NICU and 28 from a low-morbidity community-based inborn NICU), balanced using propensity score matching.
finding: Prematurity-associated morbidities correlate with autonomic development in premature infants, showing lower autonomic tone and differing maturational trajectories for most time-domain heart rate variability metrics in the high-morbidity cohort.
